data: Pour les vacances, Gabriel et Iris retournent dans une maison de famille au Portugal avec leurs filles Emma et Zoé, d’irrésistibles jumelles de 6 ans. Au coeur d’un paysage solaire, des baignades et des rires des petites, le passé du couple se réveille. Emma est dépassée par un secret trop grand pour elle, qu’elle n’a pas le droit de partager avec sa jumelle. (For their summer vacation, Iris and Gabriel return to their family house in Portugal with their adorable six-year-old twins, Emma and Zoé. In this sun-drenched landscape, between swims in the river and their children's laughter, the couple's past begins to rear its head. Emma is overwhelmed by a secret that is too big for her to carry, a secret that she is not allowed to share with her sister.)

Au coeur d’un paysage solaire, des baignades et des rires des petites, le passé du couple se réveille. Emma est dépassée par un secret trop grand pour elle, qu’elle n’a pas le droit de partager avec sa jumelle.

For their summer vacation, Iris and Gabriel return to their family house in Portugal with their adorable six-year-old twins, Emma and Zoé. In this sun-drenched landscape, between swims in the river and their children's laughter, the couple's past begins to rear its head. Emma is overwhelmed by a secret that is too big for her to carry, a secret that she is not allowed to share with her sister.
